title: The prompt asks for PAT Margin to show "NM" only where Total Income is zero or negative, but the golden formula shows "NM" whenever PAT/Total Income is negative. Total Income is always positive here, so a solver following the prompt gets numeric margins in two cells where the key expects "NM".
evidence: Golden P&L J35 = 'NM' and Q35 = 'NM', both from =IF(J34/J12<0,"NM",J34/J12). P&L J12 = 84.94 and Q12 = 73.28 are positive, so the prompt's rule gives about -0.0090 and -0.0247.
confirmation: Prompt says show "NM" where Total Income is zero or negative, but golden P&L J35/Q35 use =IF(J34/J12<0,"NM",...) and show NM although J12 = 84.94 and Q12 = 73.28 are positive; a prompt-following solver gets numeric margins and fails these modification cells.

title: The golden workbook adds a label in a cell that is empty in the input and is not mentioned in the task. Because P&L A2:Q35 is compared cell by cell, any solver who leaves the cell untouched fails.
evidence: Golden P&L A13 = 'Esc. %'. Input P&L A13 is empty (only B13 = 'Expenses'). The answer_position includes 'P&L'!A2:Q35.
confirmation: Golden P&L!A13 = 'Esc. %' while input A13 is empty and nothing in the prompt asks for it; it is a modification cell inside 'P&L'!A2:Q35, so every solver who leaves it blank fails (all modification cells must match).
